headline: Waters Corporation Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
summary: Waters Corporation reported third quarter 2026 total revenue of $1.767 billion, exceeding the guidance midpoint by $14 million. Growth was driven by organic revenue increases of 9% as reported and 10% in constant currency.
why: Waters Corporation is a prominent analytical laboratory instrument and software company serving life sciences, materials, and food industries, making its earnings results a key indicator of demand in scientific research and pharmaceutical development sectors.

impacts.name: Waters Corporation
impacts.why: Reported quarterly revenues beating guidance midpoint and strong organic growth.
